propositions: A new glob-triggered advisory code-review overlay must flag when a write-op parameter, guard, or required-field surface changes on one adapter (lib, CLI, MCP) without sibling adapters being updated in lockstep.

The surface-parity overlay fires on diffs touching _commands/**, _lib_writes.py, or _mcp_writes.py and remains inert on unrelated changes; it is wired into code-review gate round_a and round_b batches so the finder is actually dispatched.

The overlay is advisory (blocking_enabled=false, block_threshold=0.95) with false-positive guards for deliberate justified divergences, adapter-bound params, and internal-only refactors; a compliant lockstep change or justified divergence returns no finding.

Registry OVERLAY_IDS, criteria_routing.json, code-review-base.md catalog, and code-review.yaml round batches must all be updated; index.json stays unchanged because overlay prompts are excluded from the selection catalog by design.
